EVERY DOLLAR GENERAL IN AMERICA

20,488 stores plotted — every store in Dollar General's official store directory (Oct 28, 2026; coordinates from the store pages, Apr–Oct 2026) — 20,514 stores listed.
Method: each point is the coordinate Dollar General itself publishes on that store's official page — not a geocode or an estimate. Store coordinates collected by All The Places from Dollar General's official store pages. Three independent crawls (April, June and October 2026) were unioned by store number and cross-checked — where crawls overlap, zero coordinate disagreements. Spot-verified against US Census geography (60-store random sample, 60/60 in the right state). The gap: Dollar General reports 21,148 stores in total (Jul 31, 2026); its public directory lists 20,514 — this map plots the 20,488 directory stores with a published coordinate. 26 directory stores had no published coordinate in any crawl; they are listed below by name and are NOT plotted — no guessed dots. Map compiled by ATCSTW.
